sources.summary: Turning a simulation idea into a working application means assembling assets, connecting physics and rendering, and checking that the scene behaves as intended. Developers are combining frontier AI models with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to help carry out that work — building applications for exploring scenarios, investigating failures and improving designs. Developers direct AI agents through […]
sources.summary_zh: 將模擬構想轉化為可運作的應用程式，意味著組合資產、連結物理與算繪，並檢查場景是否如預期般運作。開發者正將前沿 AI 模型與 輝達 Omniverse 程式庫結合，以協助執行該項工作——建構用於探索情境、調查故障以及改善設計的應用程式。開發者透過 […] 指導 AI 代理程式
